description: What micro1's, Telegraph's and Grepped's own public estimators give for a company's records, from team size, years in business and headquarters (revenue optional, Grepped only). Each range is the buyer's formula, checked against its live page on the date given; none is an offer and Dataconto adds no figure of its own. Pass offer_usd (and offer_from) to place an offer the owner received against each range and the offering buyer's published range. Also returns the other listed buyers these answers don't rule out.

country.description: Headquarters: us, uk, ca, au, eu4 (Ireland, Netherlands, Germany or France), eu (another EU country), in, sg, other. Default us.

offer_usd.description: An offer the owner received, in US dollars.

revenue.description: Annual revenue band, Grepped only. Default undisclosed.

staff.description: People now, or at the peak.

status.description: Default operating. micro1's estimator covers running companies only.

name: estimate
title: Run three buyers' published payout estimators
